column1: # zaproxy/action-baseline's fail_action:true fails the job on ANY alert —
# WARN or FAIL, there's no "block only on FAIL" middle ground in this action.
# So every currently-known finding below is IGNOREd (dated, with a reason),
# rather than leaving DAST permanently red until Phase 3 ships and people
# start tuning it out. Remove a line once its underlying gap is actually
# fixed, so a regression on that specific header/config shows up as a real
# Baseline captured 2026-09-04 against the pre-Phase-1 placeholder frontend

column3: (Missing Anti-clickjacking Header) — add X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors via CloudFront response headers policy or hooks.server.ts, then remove this line.
(X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing) — add nosniff via the same mechanism, then remove.

(Content Security Policy Header Not Set) — needs real design work (inline script/style sources for SvelteKit hydration) before it can be added without breaking the app; deliberately deferred, not a false positive.
(Storable and Cacheable Content) — informational; deploy-frontend.yml already sets deliberate cache-control per asset type. Revisit only if this flags something unexpected.
(Permissions Policy Header Not Set) — add via CloudFront response headers policy, then remove.
(Base64 Disclosure) — near-certain false positive on bundled JS containing base64-looking strings (fonts/icons). Revisit if a real secret ever shows up here.
(Cross-Domain Misconfiguration) — expected for a public static asset host. Revisit if this ever flags something unexpected.
(Modern Web Application) — informational only, not a finding (ZAP noting the site uses a JS framework).
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy Header Missing) — add via CloudFront response headers policy, then remove.
(Sec-Fetch-Dest Header is Missing) — a request header ZAP itself didn't send, not something the frontend can set; near-certain false positive from the baseline scan's own request shape.
